name: Adaptive Octree Generation with Flatness Criterion
definition: Generates an adaptive octree for isosurface extraction by refining nodes based on surface intersection flatness, assigning vertex values via Euclidean distance transform sampling.
summary: Adaptive Octree Generation with Flatness Criterion is a method that recursively refines octree nodes based on curvature-to-area ratios to resolve highly curved regions with higher density while keeping flat regions coarse.
